intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Arlington for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from December 1 (Winter Wonderland in the Little City at Founders Row) through December 11, with Light Up Clarendon (December 2), Light the Plaza (December 3), The Lodge at Metropolitan Park (December 5), Miracle on 23rd Street at Melwood Arlington (December 11) and the Ballston Holiday Market at Welburn Square (December 11) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Arlington

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Arlington
  • 5 free events, including Winter Wonderland in the Little City, Light Up Clarendon, Light the Plaza, The Lodge and Miracle on 23rd Street
  • Meet Santa: Winter Wonderland in the Little City in Falls Church (December 1), The Lodge (December 5) and Miracle on 23rd Street (December 11)
  • Tree lightings and festivals: Light Up Clarendon (December 2), Light the Plaza (December 3), The Lodge: National Landing's Winter Festival (December 5) and the Ballston Holiday Market with its tree lighting (December 11)
  • Trains: holiday train rides at The Lodge at Metropolitan Park (December 5) and at Winter Wonderland in the Little City (December 1)
  • Season: December 1 to December 11

Planning a bigger day out? Arlington families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Washington, DC, which covers ZooLights, the National Christmas Tree and the Nutcracker at the Warner Theatre.
